overview.h1: What we do, and how we do it.
overview.subhead: Four focused practices. One close-knit team. Built in Tetouan.
overview.howWeWork: We run fixed-scope, fixed-price projects with weekly demos and a shared Notion workspace. No scope creep, no surprise invoices — just clean code delivered on schedule.
overview.faqHeadline: Things people ask before they reach out.
overview.ctaBody: Tell us what you're building. We'll scope it, price it, and deliver it.
overview.s01Body: Web apps, internal tools, API integrations, and mobile apps built to last.
overview.s02Body: Performant online stores with custom checkout, inventory, and fulfilment.
overview.s03Body: Bootcamps and workshops for teams and individuals — React, Node, Laravel, and more.
overview.s04Body: Brand-consistent content, community management, and digital strategy.
overview.faq01Q: How long does a typical project take?
overview.faq01A: Most projects run 6–16 weeks from kickoff. We give you a timeline before you sign anything.
overview.faq02Q: Do you work with international clients?
overview.faq02A: Yes. Most of our communication is async and in English or French. Calls are scheduled around your timezone.
overview.faq03A: Fixed-price per project. We scope carefully upfront so there are no surprises.
overview.faq04A: Yes — maintenance contracts available. Most clients keep us on for 6-12 months post-launch.
overview.faq05Q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
overview.faq05A: Sometimes. We do a paid 1-week audit first so we can give you an honest answer about what it'll take.
